headline: Flood Warning issued October 11 at 4:21PM EDT until October 11 at 4:30PM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
areaDesc: Allegheny, PA; Beaver, PA; Butler, PA; Washington, PA; Westmoreland, PA

details.label: Areas
details.text: Allegheny, PA; Beaver, PA; Butler, PA; Washington, PA; Westmoreland, PA

details.label: Alert detail
details.text:
The Flood Warning will expire at 430 PM EDT this afternoon for
portions of southwest, west central, and western Pennsylvania,
including the following areas, in southwest Pennsylvania, Allegheny,
Washington and Westmoreland. In west central Pennsylvania, Butler. In
western Pennsylvania, Beaver.

The heavy rain has ended and flood waters have or will continue to
recede. Flooding is no longer expected to pose a threat. Please
continue to heed remaining road closures.
